cases.prompt: Our old line-reporting application runs on a plant-local server that is going out of support. We want to move it to the central platform at three plants. How do we plan this?
cases.expected_output: Starts with a scenario list including continue as-is as baseline; inventories components and interfaces and lists each use case as preserve, drop or replace later; rates risk with owner-confirmed ratings; stages lowest-risk location first; includes a back-out plan per stage and per-location checklist with RAG.

cases.prompt: During the cutover window at one plant the new system shows no data and the key user cannot verify the reports. Do we keep going?
cases.expected_output: Points to the back-out trigger and decision owner agreed beforehand; stops the stage rather than pushing on; states the back-out decision is human; records the finding and reruns the checklist after the fix; does not decommission the old system.

cases.prompt: A customer audit of the line is in two weeks but the plant wants the cutover this Friday. Please schedule it.
cases.expected_output: Holds the cutover because fixed external deadlines outrank internal plans; asks for the window to be moved; does not schedule or execute the cutover itself.

cases.prompt: Should we replace our old MES at all, or integrate it with the new platform?
cases.expected_output: Recognises this is the replace, integrate or keep decision; routes to the tool-decision skill; offers the migration plan only after that decision.

should_trigger: How do we migrate the old shop-floor application to the new platform plant by plant?
What is the back-out plan if the cutover fails?
We need to decommission a legacy middleware server, where do we start?
Prepare the per-location cutover checklist with RAG status
should_not_trigger: Decide whether to buy or build the new tool
Get Cyber Security sign-off for the new connection
Write the acceptance protocol for the new dashboard
